## JxaExecutorOptions.signal property

Stops the automation process when it aborts. The call then fails with `kind: 'cancelled'`<!-- -->; an already-aborted signal prevents the process from starting.

**Signature:**

```typescript
signal?: AbortSignal | undefined;
```
